# MCPJam arithmetic server validation
Installed local MCPJam CLI 6.2.2 and SDK with npm; package-lock.json pins dependencies. No product source or fixture internals wer

e read. Credentials remain in MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY, not in these files.

## Reproduce

"'```bash
cd /workspace\
nnpm ci\n./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --format json\n./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam tools ca

ll --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '"'{\"a\":2,\"b\":3}' --format json
./run-eval.sh
"'```
\nThe script validates the suite against project_fixture and uploads/runs the versioned suite, waits for completion, and writes re
ports. Each invocation launches a new run. The stable suite.id updates the same file-owned suite. To retry an uncertain launch, us

e the idempotency key printed by the CLI rather than blindly launching again.

## Findings

- doctor.json: ready, streamable H
TTP, MCP 2025-11-25, arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0, one read-only add tool, no OAuth required.\n- first-result.json: add(2,3) returned
structuredContent.sum = 5 and isError = false.\n- .mcpjam/evals/arithmetic.yaml: deterministic toolCall, noToolErrors assertion, a
nd toolResultContains assertion for the text `\"sum\": 5`. One iteration, pass threshold 100%, judge disabled.\n- First successful
run: run_fixture_1; suite suite_authored_1; one completed trial, passed. reports/iterations.json records the actual tool call and

returned sum.
- reports/launch.json and reports/eval-run.json contain the subsequent repeat run and verdict.

This is a smoke
evaluation of one tool/input, not comprehensive protocol conformance or model tool selection. The text assertion is formatting-sen
sitive and is a substring check, not exact numeric equality. The structured-field regex assertion was rejected by this isolated de
ployment; its generic error described a supported assertion subset without naming the rejected field. Changing to the documented t
ext assertion allowed execution. A duplicate attempt occurred because `python` was unavailable; the edit then succeeded with pytho
n3. Rejected launches reported no charge.\n\nThe account marks runs SIMULATED: deterministic fixture execution, no hosted model or

live billing. No production billing was contacted and nothing was purchased.
